name: testsets5.k
smt:
; ================
; === Options: ===
; ================

(set-option :smt.macro-finder true)

; ======================
; === String Theory: ===
; ======================

; Z3 4.13.0+ requires explicit logic or theory declaration for strings
(set-logic ALL)

; ===========================
; === Built-in datatypes: ===
; ===========================

(define-sort Ref () Int)

(declare-datatypes (T1 T2) ((Tuple2 (mk-Tuple2 (_1 T1)(_2 T2)))))
(declare-datatypes (T1 T2 T3) ((Tuple3 (mk-Tuple3 (_1 T1)(_2 T2)(_3 T3)))))


; ===============================
; === User-defined datatypes: ===
; ===============================

(declare-datatypes () ((TopLevelDeclarations (mk-TopLevelDeclarations (Null Int)))))
(declare-datatypes () ((Car (mk-Car (vin Int)))))
(declare-datatypes () ((Garage (mk-Garage (cars (Set Ref))))))
(declare-datatypes () ((Honda (mk-Honda (vin Int)(streetValue Int)))))
(declare-datatypes () ((ChopShop (mk-ChopShop (cars (Set Ref))(goodCars (Set Ref))))))

; =============
; === Heap: ===
; =============

(declare-datatypes () ((Any
  (lift-TopLevelDeclarations (sel-TopLevelDeclarations TopLevelDeclarations))
  (lift-Car (sel-Car Car))
  (lift-Garage (sel-Garage Garage))
  (lift-Honda (sel-Honda Honda))
  (lift-ChopShop (sel-ChopShop ChopShop))
  null))
)

(declare-const heap (Array Ref Any))
(declare-const NULL$ String)
(declare-const NULL$Ref Ref)
(assert (= NULL$Ref (- 1)))

(define-fun deref ((ref Ref)) Any
  (select heap ref)
)

; ==========================================
; === Class specific is/deref-functions: ===
; ==========================================

(define-fun deref-is-TopLevelDeclarations ((this Ref)) Bool
  (is-lift-TopLevelDeclarations (deref this))
)

(define-fun deref-TopLevelDeclarations ((this Ref)) TopLevelDeclarations
  (sel-TopLevelDeclarations (deref this))
)

(define-fun deref-is-Car ((this Ref)) Bool
  (is-lift-Car (deref this))
)

(define-fun deref-Car ((this Ref)) Car
  (sel-Car (deref this))
)

(define-fun deref-is-Garage ((this Ref)) Bool
  (is-lift-Garage (deref this))
)

(define-fun deref-Garage ((this Ref)) Garage
  (sel-Garage (deref this))
)

(define-fun deref-is-Honda ((this Ref)) Bool
  (is-lift-Honda (deref this))
)

(define-fun deref-Honda ((this Ref)) Honda
  (sel-Honda (deref this))
)

(define-fun deref-is-ChopShop ((this Ref)) Bool
  (is-lift-ChopShop (deref this))
)

(define-fun deref-ChopShop ((this Ref)) ChopShop
  (sel-ChopShop (deref this))
)

; ======================
; === Isa-functions: ===
; ======================

(define-fun deref-isa-TopLevelDeclarations ((this Ref)) Bool
  (deref-is-TopLevelDeclarations this)
)

(define-fun deref-isa-Car ((this Ref)) Bool
  (or
    (deref-is-Car this)
    (deref-is-Honda this)
  )
)

(define-fun deref-isa-Garage ((this Ref)) Bool
  (or
    (deref-is-Garage this)
    (deref-is-ChopShop this)
  )
)

(define-fun deref-isa-Honda ((this Ref)) Bool
  (deref-is-Honda this)
)

(define-fun deref-isa-ChopShop ((this Ref)) Bool
  (deref-is-ChopShop this)
)

; ================
; === Getters: ===
; ================

; -------------------------------------------
;   Getters for class TopLevelDeclarations:
; -------------------------------------------

; --- getters for TopLevelDeclarations.Null: ---

(define-fun TopLevelDeclarations!Null ((this Ref)) Int
  (Null (deref-TopLevelDeclarations this))
)

; --------------------------
;   Getters for class Car:
; --------------------------

; --- getters for Car.vin: ---

(define-fun Car.vin ((this Ref)) Int
  (ite (deref-is-Car this) (vin (deref-Car this))
  (vin (deref-Honda this)))
)

; -----------------------------
;   Getters for class Garage:
; -----------------------------

; --- getters for Garage.cars: ---

(define-fun Garage!cars ((this Ref)) (Set Ref)
  (cars (deref-Garage this))
)

; ----------------------------
;   Getters for class Honda:
; ----------------------------

; --- getters for Honda.streetValue: ---

(define-fun Honda.streetValue ((this Ref)) Int
  (streetValue (deref-Honda this))
)

; -------------------------------
;   Getters for class ChopShop:
; -------------------------------

; --- getters for ChopShop.cars: ---

(define-fun ChopShop!cars ((this Ref)) (Set Ref)
  (cars (deref-ChopShop this))
)

; --- getters for ChopShop.goodCars: ---

(define-fun ChopShop!goodCars ((this Ref)) (Set Ref)
  (goodCars (deref-ChopShop this))
)

; ================
; === Methods: ===
; ================

; ===================
; === Invariants: ===
; ===================

; ---------------------------------------------
;   Invariant for class TopLevelDeclarations:
; ---------------------------------------------

; --- Constants: ---

(declare-const const-0-TopLevelDeclarations TopLevelDeclarations)

; --- Invariant 1: ---

(define-fun TopLevelDeclarations.inv1 ((this Ref)) Bool
  (= (TopLevelDeclarations!Null this) 0)
)

(assert (! (TopLevelDeclarations.inv1 0) :named _xkassert0))



; ----------------------------
;   Invariant for class Car:
; ----------------------------

; --- Constants: ---

(declare-const const-4-Car Car)



; -------------------------------
;   Invariant for class Garage:
; -------------------------------

; --- Constants: ---

(declare-const const-2-Garage Garage)

; --- Invariant 1: ---

(define-fun Garage.inv1 ((this Ref)) Bool
  (forall ((c Ref)) (=> (select (Garage!cars this) c) (not (= (Car.vin c) (TopLevelDeclarations!Null 0)))))
)

(assert (! (Garage.inv1 2) :named _xkassert1))



; ------------------------------
;   Invariant for class Honda:
; ------------------------------

; --- Constants: ---

(declare-const const-1-Honda Honda)



; ---------------------------------
;   Invariant for class ChopShop:
; ---------------------------------

; --- Constants: ---

(declare-const const-3-ChopShop ChopShop)

; --- Invariant 1: ---

(define-fun ChopShop.inv1 ((this Ref)) Bool
  (forall ((c Ref)) (=> (select (ChopShop!cars this) c) (not (= (Car.vin c) (TopLevelDeclarations!Null 0)))))
)

(assert (! (ChopShop.inv1 3) :named _xkassert2))

; --- Invariant 2: ---

(define-fun ChopShop.inv2 ((this Ref)) Bool
  (subset (ChopShop!goodCars this) (ChopShop!cars this))
)

(assert (! (ChopShop.inv2 3) :named _xkassert3))

; --- Invariant 3: ---

(define-fun ChopShop.inv3 ((this Ref)) Bool
  (forall ((gc Ref)) (=> (select (ChopShop!goodCars this) gc) (> (Honda.streetValue gc) 5000)))
)

(assert (! (ChopShop.inv3 3) :named _xkassert4))




; ======================
; === Generate heap: ===
; ======================

(assert
  (=
    heap
    (store(store(store(store(store
      ((as const (Array Ref Any)) null)
        0 (lift-TopLevelDeclarations const-0-TopLevelDeclarations))
        4 (lift-Car const-4-Car))
        2 (lift-Garage const-2-Garage))
        1 (lift-Honda const-1-Honda))
        3 (lift-ChopShop const-3-ChopShop))
  )
)
smtModel:
(define-fun const-3-ChopShop () ChopShop
  (mk-ChopShop ((as const (Array Int Bool)) true)
             ((as const (Array Int Bool)) false)))
(define-fun const-4-Car () Car
  (mk-Car 38))
(define-fun const-2-Garage () Garage
  (mk-Garage ((as const (Array Int Bool)) false)))
(define-fun const-1-Honda () Honda
  (mk-Honda 6 38))
(define-fun const-0-TopLevelDeclarations () TopLevelDeclarations
  (mk-TopLevelDeclarations 0))
(define-fun _xkassert2 () Bool
  (forall ((c Int))
  (let ((a!1 (select (cars (sel-ChopShop (select heap 3))) c))
        (a!2 (ite (is-lift-Car (select heap c))
                  (vin (sel-Car (select heap c)))
                  (vin (sel-Honda (select heap c))))))
  (let ((a!3 (= a!2 (Null (sel-TopLevelDeclarations (select heap 0))))))
    (=> a!1 (not a!3))))))
(define-fun _xkassert0 () Bool
  (= (Null (sel-TopLevelDeclarations (select heap 0))) 0))
(define-fun _xkassert3 () Bool
  (subset (goodCars (sel-ChopShop (select heap 3)))
        (cars (sel-ChopShop (select heap 3)))))
(define-fun _xkassert1 () Bool
  (forall ((c Int))
  (let ((a!1 (select (cars (sel-Garage (select heap 2))) c))
        (a!2 (ite (is-lift-Car (select heap c))
                  (vin (sel-Car (select heap c)))
                  (vin (sel-Honda (select heap c))))))
  (let ((a!3 (= a!2 (Null (sel-TopLevelDeclarations (select heap 0))))))
    (=> a!1 (not a!3))))))
(define-fun _xkassert4 () Bool
  (forall ((gc Int))
  (let ((a!1 (select (goodCars (sel-ChopShop (select heap 3))) gc))
        (a!2 (> (streetValue (sel-Honda (select heap gc))) 5000)))
    (=> a!1 a!2))))
(define-fun NULL$Ref () Int
  (- 1))
(define-fun k!heap_full!Honda () Bool
  true)
(define-fun heap () (Array Int Any)
  (let ((a!1 (store (store ((as const (Array Int Any)) null)
                         0
                         (lift-TopLevelDeclarations (mk-TopLevelDeclarations 0)))
                  4
                  (lift-Car (mk-Car 38)))))
(let ((a!2 (store a!1
                  2
                  (lift-Garage (mk-Garage ((as const (Array Int Bool)) false))))))
  (store (store a!2 1 (lift-Honda (mk-Honda 6 38)))
         3
         (lift-ChopShop (mk-ChopShop ((as const (Array Int Bool)) true)
                                     ((as const (Array Int Bool)) false)))))))
(define-fun k!heap_full!Car () Bool
  true)
(define-fun k!heap_full!ChopShop () Bool
  true)
(define-fun k!heap_full!Garage () Bool
  true)
